main.description: An event: an org-owned container context for a meeting or assembly. This record exists only while the context is public; private events stay in the org store and are never records. The group/event kind split is carried by the NSID itself (wiki.radikal.event vs wiki.radikal.group), not by a field.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier, unique among siblings under the same parent.

parent.description: Optional: the parent context (a wiki.radikal.group or wiki.radikal.event record). Set only when the parent context is itself public; a private parent is simply omitted.
